meta.name: The Secret In Their Eyes
meta.description: Hoping to put to rest years of unease concerning a past case, retired criminal investigator Benjamín begins writing a novel based on the unsolved mystery of a newlywed’s rape and murder. With the help of a former colleague, judge Irene, he attempts to make sense of the past.
meta.slogan: An unsolved crime. A love story. An unwritten ending.
